modes.name: Mode A: Managed Cloud Workspace
modes.where_documents_stored: Encrypted tenant storage (AES-256) during active projects
modes.prompts_and_questions: Stored in encrypted project history; never used for training
modes.what_reaches_assure: Workspace files, verification states, and billing telemetry
modes.model_providers: Customer API keys (BYOK) or managed endpoints; zero markup
modes.encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit; AES-256 at rest
modes.retention_and_deletion: User-controlled project purge; deleted on account closure
modes.audit_logs: Exported with every verified DOCX/PDF deliverable

modes.name: Mode B: Customer VPC / Self-Hosted
modes.where_processing_runs: Customer's own AWS account, VPC, or on-premises servers
modes.where_documents_stored: Customer's internal storage; zero document egress to Assure
modes.prompts_and_questions: Retained strictly inside the customer perimeter
modes.model_providers: Customer private endpoints (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, local models)
modes.retention_and_deletion: Governed by customer IT lifecycle policies
modes.audit_logs: Stored locally and exported with deliverables

topology: Managed Cloud Workspace (app.getassureai.com) or Customer VPC / On-Premises inside your own AWS account or servers.
residency: Zero model training on customer files. In Customer VPC mode, zero documents or prompts ever reach Assure servers.
byok: Connect your own Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, or OpenAI keys with zero token markup.
subprocessors_note: These apply to Mode A only. Mode B requires zero external Assure subprocessors.
dpa_statement: A data processing agreement and security pack are available on request.
